statement: A completed broad-write call carries an approval identifier, durable idempotency fingerprint, bounded scope, effect identifier, and audit artifact.

provenance.source_label: Bounded call receipt schema and regression fixture

verification.method: Validate a completed broad-write receipt and its linked operation, approval, and effect examples.
verification.expected_observation: Every required identifier, digest, scope, and audit artifact satisfies schema release 2.0.1.

limitations: Contract validation establishes document shape and cross-example coherence rather than a deployed authorization boundary.
recheck_triggers: The operation, approval, effect, or call-receipt contract changes.
A downstream implementation adopts a different effect-class model.
